Guo Ruize is a dutiful son. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering in 2016, Guo joined his father’s laser-cutting factory in the northeastern city of Shenyang.

At the time, factory management was largely paper-based. A clipboard hung on a workshop wall. Managers would grab it to scribble handwritten changes to the production schedule as new orders came in.
